rationale_evidence.anchor: union is a JOIN-semilattice op (monotone); retract is NON-monotone. They are compatible ONLY IF Sigma is DERIVED from the evidence set each time. ... OR-merge + retract TOGETHER FORCE Sigma to be DERIVED, not stored.
